findings.title: Missing Content-Security-Policy header
findings.detail: Response from https://solaudit-web.vercel.app/ does not include the content-security-policy header.
findings.plainWhy: Without a content policy, a single injected script (e.g. through a vulnerable plugin) can skim customer data from pages.
findings.fixHint: Add a Content-Security-Policy header starting restrictive and loosening as needed.

findings.title: Missing HSTS header
findings.detail: Response from https://solaudit-web.vercel.app/ does not include the strict-transport-security header.
findings.plainWhy: Browsers are not told to always use the secure version of the site, which leaves room for downgrade tricks on public Wi-Fi.
findings.fixHint: Add a Strict-Transport-Security header (most hosts have a one-click setting).

findings.title: Missing X-Frame-Options header
findings.detail: Response from https://solaudit-web.vercel.app/ does not include the x-frame-options header.
findings.plainWhy: The site can be embedded inside a look-alike page (clickjacking) to trick visitors into clicking things they cannot see.

findings.title: Missing X-Content-Type-Options header
findings.detail: Response from https://solaudit-web.vercel.app/ does not include the x-content-type-options header.
findings.plainWhy: Browsers may misinterpret uploaded files, a small but real opening for certain attacks.

findings.title: Missing Referrer-Policy header
findings.detail: Response from https://solaudit-web.vercel.app/ does not include the referrer-policy header.
findings.plainWhy: The site may leak which page a visitor came from when they click outbound links.

findings.title: No security.txt contact file
findings.plainWhy: When a researcher finds a real problem, there is no published way to tell the business privately.
findings.fixHint: Publish a short security.txt with a contact email (free generator at securitytxt.org).
